rationale: Followed the brief's scene in the white/off-white/grey palette; light set to upper-left to match the real pack shots. Props, tints and textures kept in outer or lower areas so the copy and photo zones stay empty. Situation briefs evoke the moment without people or product.

variants.axis_value: Pale stone surface, diagonal window light, pebbles low
variants.image_prompt: Create a photographic background image: a straight-on view of a smooth pale stone surface #F4F2EE meeting an off-white #FFFFFF wall. Three small smooth pebbles in warm grey #E5E9EA sit along the bottom edge. Lighting: soft window light from the upper left at 5600K, one gentle diagonal window shadow across the far upper-left, shadows falling to the lower right. Background: fine-grain matte stone, off-white wall, shallow depth. Style: clinical editorial, single light source. The left half of the frame is intentionally empty, an even low-detail field for headline copy added later. The right 45% of the frame is intentionally empty, an evenly lit open area reserved for a photo placed later. The bottom quarter of the frame stays plain and calm. Square 1:1, 1024x1024, 50mm lens at f/8 so the whole surface is sharp, fine photographic detail, no film grain. Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.
variants.negative_prompt: Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.

asset_requirements: real pack shot composited by the tool
